[[Jayne's Staff]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[staff]] dropped by [[Jayne Forestlight]], a [[boss]] in [[The Eternal Grove (explorable area)]].

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +10
:[[Fire damage]]: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Divine Favor]])
:Halves skill recharge of [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)
:Halves casting time of [[Protection Prayers]] [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)
:[[Enchantments]] last 20% longer
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Holy Branch]].

==Replica==
Except for the visual appearance, it is possible to create an exact technical replica for this item with:
*One of the following [[Divine Favor]] [[staves]]:
**[[Holy Staff]] from collector [[Nord Stonegrimm]]
**[[Lotus Staff]] from collector [[Kristoffir Roi]]
**[[Protective Staff]] from collectors [[Jung Zeng]] or [[Denos Makaluum]] or crafters [[Manzo]], [[Mathilde]], or [[Theodosus]]
**[[Charr Staff]] from collector [[Tuomas]] (requires [[Bonus Mission Pack]])
**[[Mursaat Staff]] from collector [[Diane]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
**[[Tengu Staff]] from collector [[Akemi]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
**[[Undead Staff]] from collector [[Archivist of Whispers]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
*[[Perfect]] [[Hale]] [[Staff Head]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Staff Wrapping]] [[of Enchanting]]
